svg.text: The 12 lines of AG(2,3) on d = 1 + x + 3y
Four parallel classes, three lines each. Every class partitions the nine points; two points lie on exactly one line.
● = a 15-line (one of the eight Lo Shu lines). The x = c class is the three +3-orbits, the columns of every lift grid.
9 points, 12 lines, 4 classes, 3 points per line, each point on 4 lines. The 8 dotted lines are exactly the Lo Shu lines.
